This could be seen as a way to ensure that their own resources are used efficiently. If the barista is already earning enough, maybe the person feels that their money could be better spent elsewhere. It could imply that the person is only tipping when they feel it's necessary, rather than consistently showing appreciation. I also need to consider the broader context of tipping culture. If a person stops tipping because others are doing it, they might be relying on the assumption that others will always cover the barista's earnings.
